name: Axiom Ward
description: Hold a ward built on a first truth of order so that blows contrary to that truth cannot land.

name: Law Torrent
description: Loose the law as a torrent of ordered force over a wide area and flatten all that stands in it.

name: Scripture Seal
description: Read a verse of the scripture over a foe and seal both its qi and its technique.

name: Mending Verse
description: Recite a verse that sets right the qi and flesh of an ally and strips every curse from them.

name: Unyielding Canon
description: Declare a canon no force can yield and nullify every technique that contradicts it.

name: Binding Reading
description: Read the binding passage and hold a great foe motionless and powerless under its words.

name: Order Descending
description: Bring the order down upon a vast field so that its disorder is crushed flat.

name: Law Restored
description: Restore the law in all allies and bring each one's qi to its proper and strongest order.

name: Statute Unending
description: The school move that makes a statute which no breaker of laws can end while the user holds it.

name: Ledger Eternal
description: The school move that enters every blow ever owed to the user and calls the whole account in one strike.

name: Domain Eternal
description: The school move that holds a domain of lasting order where foes sink to stillness and allies rise.

name: Edict Annihilation
description: Pronounce an edict that unmakes whatever stands against it across the ceiling of its tier.

name: Origin Law
description: Speak the law beneath all laws so that what the user declares simply is so within its reach.
